# Synthetic normalized conversation fixtures

These fixtures contain invented identifiers and content. They are normalized examples, not proof of compatibility with live source adapters.

- `pi-branch.json` has a common ancestor, diverging branches, and branch-local tool-call ID reuse.
- `hermes-continuation.json` has ordered messages and a source-scoped external continuation reference.
- `codex-tools.json` has a tool call/result, an artifact, source-native fields in `extensions`, and partial tool-call capture.
